A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes, deploy and forfeit numbers and the corrected game text) with the mark E in a black strip, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-captainpiett-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Captain Piett (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 12 March 2016): Same words; “''Executor''” is in italics again. As a slip it again has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip, and the bronze disc is gone.

The same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width, and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
